title: Wow Sunflowers!
description: Changes and adds functionality to the sunflower
body:
This mod changes the appearance of sunflowers and adds variations in their opening.
In addition to the visual changes, new items and one new block have been added.

**Hit a sunflower to get seeds or cut it to get the sunflower itself Brew an oil block in a potion brewer this block allows you to move quickly if you simultaneously run and jump on it!**

You can also eat the seeds, roast them in a smoker, or roast them over a campfire.
